item.title: WPPConnect minor release: v2.4.0
item.description: Today we are releasing minor version v2.4.0 for WPPConnect with Bug Fixes, Documentation and Build System.
item.content:encoded:
Today we are releasing minor version v2.4.0 for WPPConnect with Bug Fixes, Documentation and Build System.

2.4.0 (2026-11-13)​

Bug Fixes​

  • browser: poll readiness in hidden pages (712e504)
  • browser: respect ownership during automatic cleanup (c774248)
  • bump wa-js version to 4.8.0 (#2964) (7e0dace), closes #2964
  • labels: await promises, fix method signatures and export label models (#2951) (94937ce), closes #2951
  • normalize forwarding input and run the complete test suite (b28c1d6)
  • wapi: remove unbounded new messages buffer (9532a1a)
  • wapi: serialize existing message models without extra copies (7992ab3)

Documentation​

  • adopt official WPPConnect branding and API favicon (#2946) (4d8dda6), closes #2946
  • publish canonical SDK URLs and preserve renamed references (#2959) (7ab758a), closes #2959
  • refresh API reference visual design (#2950) (fd0f11b), closes #2950
  • standardize bilingual READMEs and support guidance (672e8cc)
  • update official WPPConnect logo and API favicon (#2949) (17f73ca), closes #2949

Build System​

  • deps-dev: bump fast-uri from 3.1.7 to 3.1.9 (94f5b44)
  • deps-dev: update babel monorepo to ^7.29.13 (#2955) (77c3fb2), closes #2955
  • deps-dev: update dependency concurrently to ^10.0.7 (#2957) (a43806e), closes #2957
  • deps-dev: update dependency eslint to v10.14.0 (#2953) (bfe7d57), closes #2953
  • deps-dev: update dependency globals to ^17.14.0 (#2954) (1c34452), closes #2954
  • deps-dev: update dependency release-it to ^21.1.2 (#2952) (df15904), closes #2952
  • deps-dev: update dependency typescript-eslint to ^8.72.1 (#2943) (b912ee1), closes #2943
  • deps-dev: update dependency typescript-eslint to ^8.72.2 (#2960) (775e5ee), closes #2960
  • deps-dev: update dependency webpack to ^5.112.2 (#2942) (8bf6381), closes #2942
  • deps: bump follow-redirects from 1.16.1 to 1.16.2 (#2947) (7bff268), closes #2947
  • deps: bump undici and release-it (#2948) (7db9899), closes #2948
  • deps: bump zod, puppeteer and puppeteer-core (#2939) (349fcdc), closes #2939
  • deps: update dependency axios to ^1.21.0 (#2944) (d8576d2), closes #2944
  • deps: update dependency node to v24.22.2 (#2945) (8d2ad2b), closes #2945
  • deps: update dependency serialize-javascript to v7.1.4 (#2940) (1b44483), closes #2940

For more information, see the release page.

item.title: WA-JS minor release: v4.8.0
item.description: Today we are releasing minor version v4.8.0 for WA-JS with Features, Bug Fixes, Documentation, Build System, Continuous Integration and Chores.
item.content:encoded:
Today we are releasing minor version v4.8.0 for WA-JS with Features, Bug Fixes, Documentation, Build System, Continuous Integration and Chores.

4.8.0 (2026-11-13)​

Features​

  • call: add native controls and scoped call audio (7308cf1)

Bug Fixes​

  • chat: resolve newsletters from their own store (#3767) (4595d9e), closes #3767
  • chat: respect native newsletter action lifecycle (#3762) (5f134cb), closes #3762
  • chat: reuse the MsgStore model when reading messages (d8dd1b3)
  • deps: prevent glob amplification and retain import lint rules (#3764) (9065591), closes #3764
  • deps: prevent release tooling response-decoding crash (#3754) (dd533b7), closes #3754
  • loader: recover community participants on current WhatsApp (#3751) (13fec08), closes #3751
  • tolerate removed LID getter while preserving deprecated APIs (2d729a0), closes #2926

Documentation​

  • adopt official WPPConnect branding and API favicon (#3758) (1276b2f), closes #3758
  • publish canonical API URLs and preserve renamed references (#3775) (3b00cce), closes #3775
  • refresh API reference visual design (#3766) (6a617d4), closes #3766
  • standardize bilingual READMEs and support guidance (2479f13)
  • update official WPPConnect logo and API favicon (#3765) (e1bd9e2), closes #3765

Build System​

  • deps-dev: bump fast-uri from 3.1.8 to 3.1.9 (3ee6227)
  • deps-dev: require prettier ^3.10.1 (d2d25ff)
  • deps-dev: update dependency eslint to ^10.14.0 (#3760) (c97f9e4), closes #3760
  • deps-dev: update dependency prettier to ^3.10.0 (69b8db2)
  • deps-dev: update dependency release-it to ^21.1.2 (#3759) (1852440), closes #3759
  • deps-dev: update dependency webpack to ^5.112.2 (#3749) (59d6356), closes #3749
  • deps-dev: update dependency webpack-cli to ^7.3.1 (#3761) (96cecad), closes #3761
  • deps-dev: update playwright monorepo to ^1.65.0 (#3770) (f8c27c2), closes #3770
  • deps-dev: update typescript-eslint monorepo to ^8.72.1 (#3753) (fe73b0a), closes #3753
  • deps-dev: update typescript-eslint monorepo to ^8.72.2 (#3771) (4e0542c), closes #3771
  • deps: update node.js to v24.22.2 (#3756) (a50ccf1), closes #3756
  • deps: update node.js to v26 (#3763) (1b7c75e), closes #3763
  • deps: update node.js to v26.13.1 (cdf4cb0)

Continuous Integration​

  • deps: update dependency node to v26 (#3755) (5c5b6bb), closes #3755

Chores​

  • deps: update prettier to v3.10.1 (67f95b0)

For more information, see the release page.
